You are a helpful assistant.

botForm.deleteConfirmTasks_other: Delete {{name}}? Its folder goes to the Trash. Its {{count}} recurring tasks are deleted too.

skills.title: Skills
skills.intro: A skill is a set of instructions a bot reads before a task it covers. Write one here, or import a folder that has a SKILL.md file.
skills.unused: Not used by any bot yet
skills.name: Name

skills.folderHint: The folder name comes from the name and does not change.
skills.appliesNext: Bots that have this skill pick up the change with their next message.
skills.deleteHint: The skill leaves the library and its folder goes to the Trash.

system.session_reset: The previous conversation could not be resumed, so the bot started a new one.
system.config_new_session: The bot started a new conversation so it could pick up your changes. Its notes in MEMORY.md and this chat stay.
system.bot_start_failed: The bot could not start. Settings shows whether its AI tool is installed and signed in. Details: {{error}}

setup.title: Welcome to Sonata
setup.intro: Sonata runs AI bots on this Mac. Before your first bot, check these things.
setup.safety: Bots work on their own. They run commands and read and write files without asking you first, with the same access as your macOS user. A bot's folder is where it works, not a fence around it.
setup.folderHint: Each bot keeps its files in its own folder here. Master is created when you finish setup; this location cannot change once bots exist.
setup.folderLocked: This folder stays the same once you have bots.
setup.projectHint: Name your first project, choose its source directory and default AI provider. Master helps you create and coordinate bots within this project.
setup.toolsTitle: The AI tools bots run on
setup.toolsHint: Bots run on Claude Code, Codex, Grok or OpenCode, installed and signed in on this Mac. You need at least one.

tools.unchecked: Installed. Sonata checks the sign-in when a bot starts.
tools.noneFound: No bot CLI was found. Install Claude Code, Codex, Grok or OpenCode, then click Check again.

claude.missing: Install Claude Code. Then open Terminal, run claude, and sign in.
claude.notLoggedIn: Open Terminal, run claude, and sign in.

codex.missing: Install Codex. Then open Terminal and run codex login.
codex.notLoggedIn: Open Terminal and run codex login.

grok.missing: Install Grok. Then open Terminal and run grok login.
grok.notLoggedIn: Open Terminal and run grok login.

opencode.missing: Install OpenCode. Then open Terminal and run opencode auth login.
opencode.notLoggedIn: Open Terminal and run opencode auth login.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageHint: Bots are told your language and write to you in it. Their names, instructions and skills are never translated.
settings.hopLimit: Messages between bots for one request
settings.hopLimitHint: When bots pass work on, they stop after this many messages to each other, so two bots cannot keep each other busy forever. Work Master runs gets five times as many. Messages to Master or to you are never limited.
settings.projectHint: Master and bots it creates can use this folder. Changing it updates generated instructions and preserves instructions you edited by hand.
settings.projectKept: Saved. {{bots}} not changed: their instructions were edited by hand.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.intro: A workflow hands a request from bot to bot, one step at a time, until it reaches Done. Master runs one when a request fits it, or you run one here.
workflows.empty: No workflows yet. Ask Master, or add one here.
workflows.describeHint: Master picks a bot for each step and suggests new bots or skills where they help. Nothing is created until you approve.
workflows.describePlaceholder: e.g. Fetch our SEO metrics from a JSON endpoint, evaluate them and suggest improvements, then open a ticket for each improvement I approve.
workflows.deleteConfirm: Delete {{name}}? Its runs' sessions stay on the board.

workflowEditor.name: Name
workflowEditor.whenPlaceholder: e.g. A request to implement and review
workflowEditor.whenHint: Master reads this to choose a workflow for a request.
workflowEditor.instructionsHint: What the bot does in this step. It reads them with the request and the results of the steps before.
workflowEditor.arrowHint: Name the arrow on the canvas. When a step has several arrows, each needs a name: the bot picks one when it finishes.
workflowEditor.startArrowHint: The workflow starts with this step. To start with another, drag from Start to that step.
workflowEditor.panelHint: Select a box to edit its step. To draw an arrow, drag from the bottom edge of a box to another box or to Done. Press Delete to remove what is selected.
workflowEditor.a11yNode: Press Enter or Space to select a box. Press Delete to remove it.
workflowEditor.a11yMoved: Moved the box to x {{x}}, y {{y}}.
workflowEditor.a11yEdge: Press Enter or Space to select an arrow. Press Delete to remove it.

workflowTransfer.files: Added, removed or changed files (including executable permissions)
workflowTransfer.resolve: Resolve every required item before importing. Nothing has been written.
workflowTransfer.shared: Keeping local versions can change how this workflow behaves. Replacing shared bots or skills also affects their other users, including subsequent messages in existing sessions.

config.backupTrash: What was replaced is in the Trash as {{file}}. Import it with Add and replace to put it back.
config.backupKept: What was replaced is kept at {{path}}. Import it with Add and replace to put it back.

onboarding.intro: Tell us a little about your work. Master will suggest workflows, bots, and skills to help with your regular tasks.
onboarding.jobExample: For example: software developer, marketing manager, administrator, researcher
onboarding.tasks: Which tasks do you perform most often?
onboarding.tasksExample: For example: review code, prepare weekly reports, draft campaigns, or compare research. Mention any tools or inputs you use.
onboarding.privacy: Your answers are saved on this computer and sent to your configured AI provider when you generate suggestions.
onboarding.folderHint: Name this project and choose the folder where you keep its work, such as documents or source code. Master and your new bots use the selected AI provider.

onboarding.generating: Master is preparing suggestions for your work…
